mr_title: feat(core): add equality function to rxjs-interop `toSignal`
mr_description:
`toSignal` predates the decision to allow a more flexible equality check in
signals, and thus doesn't support a custom equality function. This commit
adds the ability to pass a custom value equality function. As a side effect,
it now adds the default equality check where it wasn't used before.

expected_issues.title: New option named 'equals' while signal APIs use 'equal'
expected_issues.description:
The new public option is named `equals`, while the equivalent option of signal()/computed() is `equal`; shipping it would freeze an inconsistent public API.

Angular's signal APIs use `equal` (CreateSignalOptions.equal, CreateComputedOptions.equal). Adding `equals` to ToSignalOptions creates an inconsistency that users will get wrong (a misspelled `equal` would be silently ignored in JS or rejected in TS), and renaming later requires a breaking change. The option should be named `equal`.

expected_issues.title: Required type parameter breaks existing ToSignalOptions users
expected_issues.description: ToSignalOptions was a public non-generic interface. Making its type parameter mandatory means existing declarations such as const options: ToSignalOptions = {requireSync: true} fail to compile. Supply a compatible default type parameter or preserve the old public form.
